# CAN ISO-TP configuration options

# Copyright (c) 2019 Alexander Wachter
# SPDX-License-Identifier: Apache-2.0

menuconfig ISOTP
	bool "ISO-TP Transport Layer"
	depends on CAN
	select NET_BUF
	help
	  Enable ISO-TP Transport Layer

if ISOTP

module = ISOTP
module-str = ISOTP
source "subsys/logging/Kconfig.template.log_config"

config ISOTP_WFTMAX
	int "Maximum wait frame transmissions"
	default 1
	range 0 255
	help
	  Defines how many times this device will wait if the receiver send wait
	  frame in the FC before abortion the transmission.

config ISOTP_TX_WORKQUEUE_STACK_SIZE
	int "TX workqueue thread stack size"
	default 1024
	help
	  Stack size of the TX workqueue thread in bytes.

config ISOTP_TX_WORKQUEUE_PRIO
	int "TX workqueue thread priority"
	default 7
	help
	  Priority of the TX workqueue thread. This thread should have a
	  lower priority than the CAN RX thread.

config ISOTP_BS_TIMEOUT
	int "N_Bs timeout in milliseconds"
	default 1000
	range 100 1000
	help
	  Timeout for the reception of the next Flow Control PDU. ISO 15765-2
	  specified this value to be 1000ms.

config ISOTP_A_TIMEOUT
	int "N_As and N_Ar timeout in milliseconds"
	default 1000
	range 100 1000
	help
	  Timeout for the transmission of any CAN frame on the sender or
	  receiver side. ISO 15765-2 specified this value to be 1000ms.

config ISOTP_CR_TIMEOUT
	int "N_Cr timeout in milliseconds"
	default 1000
	range 100 1000
	help
	  Timeout for the reception of the next Consecutive Frame PDU. ISO
	  15765-2 specified this value to be 1000ms.

config ISOTP_RX_BUF_COUNT
	int "Number of buffers for incoming data"
	default 4
	range 1 255
	help
	  A bound context gets one net_buf per block when receiving data.

config ISOTP_RX_BUF_SIZE
	int "Size of an RX data buffer in bytes"
	default 56
	range 7 1785
	help
	  Incoming data are dropped if there is no buffer available and can't
	  be allocated. When isotp_recv is called, the buffer gets freed.
	  For small sized data, single buffers can be divided in smaller chunks.

config ISOTP_RX_SF_FF_BUF_COUNT
	int "Number of buffers for the single and first frames"
	default 2
	range 1 255
	help
	  Each bound context gets one frame when isotp_bind is called.
	  Their size is always 7 bytes because a single or first frame can not
	  exceed 7 bytes.

menuconfig ISOTP_USE_TX_BUF
	bool "Buffering for TX data"
	help
	  Can be used to buffer data to send when isotp_send is called without
	  complete callback.

if ISOTP_USE_TX_BUF

config ISOTP_TX_BUF_COUNT
	int "Number of buffers for outgoing data"
	default 2
	range 1 255
	help
	  Defines how many send instances using buffered data can run
	  concurrently.

config ISOTP_BUF_TX_DATA_POOL_SIZE
	int "Total amount of memory in the TX global pool in bytes"
	default 256
	help
	  Total size of data that can be buffered concurrently across all send
	  calls.

endif # ISOTP_USE_TX_BUF

menuconfig ISOTP_ENABLE_CONTEXT_BUFFERS
	bool "Buffered send contexts"
	help
	  Use internal buffers for the send contexts. By using these buffers,
	  the user doesn't have to take care about the lifetime of the send
	  context.

if ISOTP_ENABLE_CONTEXT_BUFFERS

config ISOTP_Send_CONTEXT_BUFFERS
	int "Number of send context buffers"
	default 2
	range 1 255
	help
	  Defines how many send instances without context provided by the caller
	  can run concurrently.

endif # ISOTP_ENABLE_CONTEXT_BUFFERS

endif # ISOTP
